entries.wording: ตรวจสอบสินค้าและคีย์เอกสาร
entries.note: Goods checked and the consignment note keyed in at the origin branch; the oldest scan of each live history. Archived captures of the history page printed the code in brackets before the wording; the live page prints the wording alone.

entries.wording: บันทึกเอกสารและชำระเงิน
entries.note: Consignment note recorded and paid for at the origin branch. Seen in an archived capture of the tracker's history page, which prints the code in brackets before the wording.

entries.wording: รับสินค้าเข้าคลังรอจัดส่ง
entries.note: Taken into a branch's warehouse to wait for dispatch; it recurs at each branch, the destination branch's included, before the parcel goes out for delivery.

entries.wording: ดำเนินการส่งสินค้าไปที่ศูนย์กระจายสินค้า
entries.note: Sent on to a distribution centre or the next branch.

entries.wording: รับสินค้าเข้าคลังศูนย์กระจายสินค้า
entries.note: Received at a distribution centre's or a branch's warehouse.

entries.wording: ดำเนินการส่งสินค้าไปให้ลูกค้าปลายทาง
entries.note: On its way to the recipient from the destination branch; the delivery follows hours later.

entries.wording: ส่งสินค้าถึงปลายทางเรียบร้อย
entries.note: Delivered to the recipient; the history page then shows the signature and photos.

entries.wording: จัดส่งไม่ได้/รับสินค้ากลับคืนคลัง
entries.note: Not delivered and taken back into the branch's warehouse, a few minutes after the parcel went out for delivery. Quoted with its code from the tracker's history page in a public comment on Thaiware's TP Logistics page.
Held at the branch instead of going out for delivery. The history page lists a hold reason at the same minute; the parcels seen were delivered days later.

entries.wording: 3.ผู้รับขอเลื่อนวันรับสินค้า (ถ่ายรูปวันเลื่อนรับ)
entries.note: A row of the history page's hold reasons, printed with its number: the recipient asked to take the parcel on a later day, and the branch photographs the new day.
The STATUS column of the tracker's search page, which shows one summary status per parcel.
